FORM.notes: source note: tanasa指的是「房子」、「家屋」，而cani pininga則是「家庭」。發音人所要講的主題是家庭，前面提到房子應是講錯，所以標為FS。

S.FORM: teku poisua sua er tanasa er cani pininga.
S.PHON: teku poisua sua e[r|ɾ] tanasa e[r|ɾ] ʦani piniŋa
S.FORM: teku poisua sua er tanasa er cani pininga.
S.PHON: teku poisua sua e[r|ɾ] tanasa e[r|ɾ] ʦani piniŋa
S.TRANSL: 我要講關於我的家庭.
I want to talk about (my) family.

FORM.notes: source note: coomaku由cuma=maku變音而來，類似的情況如cuma=musu「你的爸爸」變音為coomusu。根據發音老師，cuma有三種念法：(1)cuma(原本的念法)；(2)coomusu, coomaku(重音在oo)；(3)Cumaa Pani, Cumaa 'Angai(後加人名的情況；重音在aa)。 | source note: cina跟cuma比起來較少變音，此句aa為重音所在。 | source note: kinvava與ia必須分開念而不能連著念。發音老師建議中間須有分音符號。 | source note: 本句的「兄弟姊妹」為老人家的說法，年輕一輩的說法為kinvara(單數)及kinvavara(複數)。

S.FORM: er miana iikim 'esipa coomaku cinaamaku er kinvavaia 'esipa kangvang.
S.PHON: e[r|ɾ] miana iikim ʔesipa ʦoomaku ʦinaamaku e[r|ɾ] kinvavaia ʔesipa kaŋvaŋ
S.FORM: er miana iikim 'esipa coomaku cinaamaku er kinvavaia 'esipa kangvang.
S.PHON: e[r|ɾ] miana iikim ʔesipa ʦoomaku ʦinaamaku e[r|ɾ] kinvavaia ʔesipa kaŋvaŋ
S.TRANSL: 以前,我爸爸還在,我媽媽,我兄弟姊妹,全部都還在.
In the past, my father was still alive, my mother and my siblings were all alive.

FORM.notes: source note: 本篇敘述裡將會出現許多makasua=cu=kim，用來對之前所說的話做一個小結，表示「我們的情況就是那樣了」。=cu為「了」的意思。 | source note: 「這樣」為makasia。

S.FORM: makasuacukim.
S.PHON: makasuaʦukim
S.FORM: makasuacukim.
S.PHON: makasuaʦukim
S.TRANSL: 以前,我爸爸還在,我媽媽,我兄弟姊妹,全部都還在.我們就那樣了.
In the past, my father was still alive, my mother and my siblings were all alive. We were so.

FORM.notes: source note: vai指「(一個)兄弟姊妹」，是向別人介紹自己手足時所用較親密的叫法。男的兄弟姊妹稱vai saronai。 | source note: 雖然此處用的詞彙是「弟弟或妹妹」，但上一句有提到是女性的手足，所以作妹妹解。 | source note: 「哥哥或姐姐(單數)」為kana'ua。 | source note: marang有「年長」、「年紀大」、「長輩」等等意思。

S.FORM: er 'unaku vai nanakʉ kanarua iiku iiku marang kanakana'ua makasuacukim.
S.PHON: e[r|ɾ] ʔunaku vai nanakɨ kana[r|ɾ]ua iiku iiku ma[r|ɾ]aŋ kanakanaʔua makasuaʦukim
S.FORM: er 'unaku vai nanakʉ kanarua iiku iiku marang kanakana'ua makasuacukim.
S.PHON: e[r|ɾ] ʔunaku vai nanakɨ kana[r|ɾ]ua iiku iiku ma[r|ɾ]aŋ kanakanaʔua makasuaʦukim
S.TRANSL: 我有一個姊妹,(更正確地說)是妹妹.我是兄弟姊妹當中年紀最大的.我們就那樣了.
I have a female sibling, (more precisely) a younger sister, I am the oldest among my siblings. We are so.

FORM.notes: source note: 重音在aa的位置，拉長音代表話還沒說完。 | source note: m-osa為m-okusa的簡化。 | source note: m-arisinatU有「寫字」、「讀書」、「上學」等等意思，此處應解為「上學」較符合上下文。另外，此處m-arisinatU變成如名詞的概念(學校；讀書的地方)，所以前面可以加上表示場所/動作目的地的助詞na。真正代表「學校」的詞彙為ta-risinata，其中ta-表示場所。 | source note: 尾音拉長可表示動作持續，也可以用重疊來表示持續：mari-sina-sinatʉ。

S.FORM: arataatiaa mosacu na marisinatU marisinatʉʉ.
S.PHON: a[r|ɾ]ataatiaa mosaʦu na ma[r|ɾ]isinatu ma[r|ɾ]isinatɨɨ
S.FORM: arataatiaa mosacu na marisinatU marisinatʉʉ.
S.PHON: a[r|ɾ]ataatiaa mosaʦu na ma[r|ɾ]isinatu ma[r|ɾ]isinatɨɨ
S.TRANSL: 長大後,就去上學了,一直讀書.
Growing up, I went to attend school and kept learning.

FORM.notes: source note: po'i可表示「回來」或「回去」。 | source note: 此處的=ci等同於=cu。以下同。 | source note: 'aan由ka'aan簡化而來，表示「不」。

S.FORM: matirupaang marisinatU po po'icikia 'aan 'aancikia marisinatU er makasuacu.
S.PHON: mati[r|ɾ]upaaŋ ma[r|ɾ]isinatu po poʔiʦikia ʔaan ʔaanʦikia ma[r|ɾ]isinatu e[r|ɾ] makasuaʦu
S.FORM: matirupaang marisinatU po po'icikia 'aan 'aancikia marisinatU er makasuacu.
S.PHON: mati[r|ɾ]upaaŋ ma[r|ɾ]isinatu po poʔiʦikia ʔaan ʔaanʦikia ma[r|ɾ]isinatu e[r|ɾ] makasuaʦu
S.TRANSL: 完成學業我就回來,我就不(繼續)讀書了.就這樣.
Finishing studying, I went back to home, I didn't (continue to) study. That was so.

FORM.notes: source note: tavarU'U為「可以」、「知道」，而tavarU'Un(受焦形式)為「可以了」、「被知道」、「被了解」等等。 | source note: 發音老師認為主焦形式的um-ara似乎有誤，因為發音人為女性，為被娶者，應用受焦形式。 | source note: kan表據說。 | source note: 'ucaang為「配偶」，而mu-ru'ucaang為「結婚(主焦)」。 | source note: 本句講得較零散，不確定中英文翻譯。

S.FORM: ta'u tavarU'Uncikia umara cau 'una Uncoo er er mamarang makasi tia kan poru poru'ucaangUn misee poru'ucaangUn muru'ucaang ai er.
S.PHON: taʔu tava[r|ɾ]uʔunʦikia uma[r|ɾ]a ʦau ʔuna unʦoo e[r|ɾ] e[r|ɾ] mama[r|ɾ]aŋ makasi tia kan po[r|ɾ]u po[r|ɾ]uʔuʦaaŋun misee po[r|ɾ]uʔuʦaaŋun mu[r|ɾ]uʔuʦaaŋ ai e[r|ɾ]
S.FORM: ta'u tavarU'Uncikia umara cau 'una Uncoo er er mamarang makasi tia kan poru poru'ucaangUn misee poru'ucaangUn muru'ucaang ai er.
S.PHON: taʔu tava[r|ɾ]uʔunʦikia uma[r|ɾ]a ʦau ʔuna unʦoo e[r|ɾ] e[r|ɾ] mama[r|ɾ]aŋ makasi tia kan po[r|ɾ]u po[r|ɾ]uʔuʦaaŋun misee po[r|ɾ]uʔuʦaaŋun mu[r|ɾ]uʔuʦaaŋ ai e[r|ɾ]
S.TRANSL: 我父母說要讓我結婚.
My parents said (that they) wanted to make me get married.

FORM.notes: source note: 本句講得顛三倒四且零零落落，是含蓄的表現。

S.FORM: er muru'ucaang erkim Mu Mu'u nganaiin Mu'u Mu'u PaicU sua nganaimia makasuacukim miana.
S.PHON: e[r|ɾ] mu[r|ɾ]uʔuʦaaŋ e[r|ɾ]kim mu muʔu ŋanaiin muʔu muʔu paiʦu sua ŋanaimia makasuaʦukim miana
S.FORM: er muru'ucaang erkim Mu Mu'u nganaiin Mu'u Mu'u PaicU sua nganaimia makasuacukim miana.
S.PHON: e[r|ɾ] mu[r|ɾ]uʔuʦaaŋ e[r|ɾ]kim mu muʔu ŋanaiin muʔu muʔu paiʦu sua ŋanaimia makasuaʦukim miana
S.TRANSL: Mu'u是他的名字,Mu'u和PaicU是我們的名字.我們以前就是那樣了.
Mu'u is his name, and Mu'u and PaicU are our names. We were so in the past.

FORM.notes: source note: 發音老師將「還」發為=pa。 | source note: ma-u-'ura為複數，其單數為ma'ura。

S.FORM: er mamarurang marangcu mamarangmaku 'aancu tavarU'U putukikio mau'urapikim mau'urapikim.
S.PHON: e[r|ɾ] mama[r|ɾ]u[r|ɾ]aŋ ma[r|ɾ]aŋʦu mama[r|ɾ]aŋmaku ʔaanʦu tava[r|ɾ]uʔu putukikio mauʔu[r|ɾ]apikim mauʔu[r|ɾ]apikim
S.FORM: er mamarurang marangcu mamarangmaku 'aancu tavarU'U putukikio mau'urapikim mau'urapikim.
S.PHON: e[r|ɾ] mama[r|ɾ]u[r|ɾ]aŋ ma[r|ɾ]aŋʦu mama[r|ɾ]aŋmaku ʔaanʦu tava[r|ɾ]uʔu putukikio mauʔu[r|ɾ]apikim mauʔu[r|ɾ]apikim
S.TRANSL: 父母年長了,我的父母年長了不能工作了,(但)我們(兄弟姊妹們)年紀還很小.
(Our) parents got aged, (our) parents got aged (so that they) could not work, (but) we (siblings) were still very young.

S.FORM: 'akia kUna 'una ai mUmUkU mUmUkU mamarang miana tanUkU tammi 'una vina'U kUna kUna miana.
S.PHON: ʔakia kuna ʔuna ai mumuku mumuku mama[r|ɾ]aŋ miana tanuku tammi ʔuna vinaʔu kuna kuna miana
S.FORM: 'akia kUna 'una ai mUmUkU mUmUkU mamarang miana tanUkU tammi 'una vina'U kUna kUna miana.
S.PHON: ʔakia kuna ʔuna ai mumuku mumuku mama[r|ɾ]aŋ miana tanuku tammi ʔuna vinaʔu kuna kuna miana
S.TRANSL: 沒有食物,長輩們以前有種芋頭、地瓜和小米.(這些是)以前的食物.
There was no food, (and our) parents grew taroes, sweet potatoes, millets in the past. (They were) the food in the past.

FORM.notes: source note: 此處的=kia解為複數。以下同。

S.FORM: makasuacikia.
S.PHON: makasuaʦikia
S.FORM: makasuacikia.
S.PHON: makasuaʦikia
S.TRANSL: 沒有食物,長輩們以前有種芋頭、地瓜和小米.(這些是)以前的食物.我們就那樣了.
There was no food, (and our) parents grew taroes, sweet potatoes, millets in the past. (They were) the food in the past. We were so.

FORM.notes: source note: marang和marurang都可以表示「年長(動詞)」或是「長輩(名詞)」，兩者均為單數；其各自的複數形式為mamarang及mamarurang。

S.FORM: masiin marang marangcikia masiin marurangcikia masiin 'akia er vaantuku 'aancikia tavarU'U kavanvaantuku marangcu miaranasUkia mamia sii 'akia manu saronai.
S.PHON: masiin ma[r|ɾ]aŋ ma[r|ɾ]aŋʦikia masiin ma[r|ɾ]u[r|ɾ]aŋʦikia masiin ʔakia e[r|ɾ] vaantuku ʔaanʦikia tava[r|ɾ]uʔu kavanvaantuku ma[r|ɾ]aŋʦu mia[r|ɾ]anasukia mamia sii ʔakia manu sa[r|ɾ]onai
S.FORM: masiin marang marangcikia masiin marurangcikia masiin 'akia er vaantuku 'aancikia tavarU'U kavanvaantuku marangcu miaranasUkia mamia sii 'akia manu saronai.
S.PHON: masiin ma[r|ɾ]aŋ ma[r|ɾ]aŋʦikia masiin ma[r|ɾ]u[r|ɾ]aŋʦikia masiin ʔakia e[r|ɾ] vaantuku ʔaanʦikia tava[r|ɾ]uʔu kavanvaantuku ma[r|ɾ]aŋʦu mia[r|ɾ]anasukia mamia sii ʔakia manu sa[r|ɾ]onai
S.TRANSL: 沒有錢,沒辦法賺錢,(因為)我年紀大了,我只有困苦著,因為(我父母)沒有男孩子.
There was no money, I couldn't make money (because) I got aged. I could only be tough, because (my parents) didn't have any boy.

FORM.notes: source note: 這句話發音人提到她只有一位兄姊，用複數型態的kana-kana'ua應是把自己算在裡面。由下文判斷此兄姊應該是哥哥，所以底下翻譯為哥哥。 | source note: 這句的na的意思為「原來的」，為過世的人的格位標記。 | source note: acecu表示「離去」，而mosa表示「行走」。 | source note: mamane可表示「人間」、「宇宙」、「地球」。

S.FORM: ucaan mamia na kanakana'uamaku acecu 'akiacu mamane.
S.PHON: uʦaan mamia na kanakanaʔuamaku aʦeʦu ʔakiaʦu mamane
S.FORM: ucaan mamia na kanakana'uamaku acecu 'akiacu mamane.
S.PHON: uʦaan mamia na kanakanaʔuamaku aʦeʦu ʔakiaʦu mamane
S.TRANSL: 我只有一位哥哥,已經走了,不在人世間了.
I only had one late older brother, (who already) left and was't in the world.

S.FORM: er cikim er cani pininga.
S.PHON: e[r|ɾ] ʦikim e[r|ɾ] ʦani piniŋa
S.FORM: er cikim er cani pininga.
S.PHON: e[r|ɾ] ʦikim e[r|ɾ] ʦani piniŋa
S.TRANSL: 我們一家人……了.
We the whole family....

FORM.notes: source note: umaraciku原為um-ara=ci=ku，意為「我娶……」，但其實發音人想說的是um-ara=ci=kim「我們(家)娶……」，所以判定前面為false start。

S.FORM: er umaraciku a umaracikim rU'UvU rU'UvU kana'uamaku ucang kana'uamaku.
S.PHON: e[r|ɾ] uma[r|ɾ]aʦiku a uma[r|ɾ]aʦikim [r|ɾ]uʔuvu [r|ɾ]uʔuvu kanaʔuamaku uʦaŋ kanaʔuamaku
S.FORM: er umaraciku a umaracikim rU'UvU rU'UvU kana'uamaku ucang kana'uamaku.
S.PHON: e[r|ɾ] uma[r|ɾ]aʦiku a uma[r|ɾ]aʦikim [r|ɾ]uʔuvu [r|ɾ]uʔuvu kanaʔuamaku uʦaŋ kanaʔuamaku
S.TRANSL: 如果那樣的話,心裡就比較舒坦一點了.
If the condition was like so, my heart would be relieved.

FORM.notes: source note: ka-表示「住」，如ka-naan=kasu「你住哪裡」。 | source note: 瑪雅里指的是高雄那瑪夏區的瑪雅里。

S.FORM: ka'anvuana ka'anvuana sua 'Uncoo niaramia.
S.PHON: kaʔanvuana kaʔanvuana sua ʔunʦoo nia[r|ɾ]amia
S.FORM: ka'anvuana ka'anvuana sua 'Uncoo niaramia.
S.PHON: kaʔanvuana kaʔanvuana sua ʔunʦoo nia[r|ɾ]amia
S.TRANSL: 我們(家)娶了我哥哥的伴侶,我哥哥的配偶,我們所娶的是住瑪雅里的.
We (our family) took my older brother's partner, my older brother's spouse, the person we took lived in NU'Uvana.

FORM.notes: source note: 發音老師認為此句有誤，應為單數的nanakU。

S.FORM: naannakU cikim arakukun mamanUUng.
S.PHON: naannaku ʦikim a[r|ɾ]akukun mamanuuŋ
S.FORM: naannakU cikim arakukun mamanUUng.
S.PHON: naannaku ʦikim a[r|ɾ]akukun mamanuuŋ
S.TRANSL: 我們……跟那個女人(哥哥的老婆)很好的相處.
We ...got along with the woman (my older brother's spouse).

FORM.notes: source note: 「之後」發音老師發為no'onaan。 | source note: 有關的時間用語：masiin「現在」、koonpa「等一下(祈使句)」、nusoon「待會兒」、no'onaan「可預測或不可預測的之後」、nuari「未來」。 | source note: 比較：mararuai為「分開」，用在分家或在叉路分開等等情況；而aratUkUn為「分離」，指兩個人不想在一起。

S.FORM: er noo no'onaniin mararuaicikim.
S.PHON: e[r|ɾ] noo noʔonaniin ma[r|ɾ]a[r|ɾ]uaiʦikim
S.FORM: er noo no'onaniin mararuaicikim.
S.PHON: e[r|ɾ] noo noʔonaniin ma[r|ɾ]a[r|ɾ]uaiʦikim
S.TRANSL: 之後我們就分開了.
Well, afterwards, we were separated from each other.

FORM.notes: source note: 本句的ka-ta-tanasa之所以有重疊，是因為房子不是一天蓋好的，重疊用來表示動作的持續。 | source note: 本句的「不同」指的是我們兩家就分家了，成了不同家的人。

S.FORM: mu mucaancu nguani katatanasa karananakim.
S.PHON: mu muʦaanʦu ŋuani katatanasa ka[r|ɾ]ananakim
S.FORM: mu mucaancu nguani katatanasa karananakim.
S.PHON: mu muʦaanʦu ŋuani katatanasa ka[r|ɾ]ananakim
S.TRANSL: 他們就離開蓋房子,跟我們不同.
They left to build (their) house, and were different from us.

FORM.notes: source note: ia傾向會變音為e，如se-rupac-a本來為sia-rupac-a。 | source note: se的意思為「用以」、「用來」，應為工具焦點。 | source note: 此句的no-nonoman應該是指農事用的工具。

S.FORM: er makasiacukim miaranasU sii 'akia nononoman serupaca.
S.PHON: e[r|ɾ] makasiaʦukim mia[r|ɾ]anasu sii ʔakia nononoman se[r|ɾ]upaʦa
S.FORM: er makasiacukim miaranasU sii 'akia nononoman serupaca.
S.PHON: e[r|ɾ] makasiaʦukim mia[r|ɾ]anasu sii ʔakia nononoman se[r|ɾ]upaʦa
S.TRANSL: 就這樣子,我們很困苦,因為沒有可以使用的各種工具.
We were tough in this way, because we didn't have the tools that we could use.

FORM.notes: source note: mataa可表示「和」、「與」、「以及」、「跟」等等。 | source note: 此處的kangvang解為「也」。 | source note: masiin「現在」為makasiin的簡化。

S.FORM: mataa er cinaamaku na cinaamaku marang kangvang na coomaku marangcu kangvang er 'akia 'akiacu masiin er 'akia 'akiacu mamane masiin.
S.PHON: mataa e[r|ɾ] ʦinaamaku na ʦinaamaku ma[r|ɾ]aŋ kaŋvaŋ na ʦoomaku ma[r|ɾ]aŋʦu kaŋvaŋ e[r|ɾ] ʔakia ʔakiaʦu masiin e[r|ɾ] ʔakia ʔakiaʦu mamane masiin
S.FORM: mataa er cinaamaku na cinaamaku marang kangvang na coomaku marangcu kangvang er 'akia 'akiacu masiin er 'akia 'akiacu mamane masiin.
S.PHON: mataa e[r|ɾ] ʦinaamaku na ʦinaamaku ma[r|ɾ]aŋ kaŋvaŋ na ʦoomaku ma[r|ɾ]aŋʦu kaŋvaŋ e[r|ɾ] ʔakia ʔakiaʦu masiin e[r|ɾ] ʔakia ʔakiaʦu mamane masiin
S.TRANSL: 原本的媽媽也年老了,原本的爸爸也年老了,現在沒有了,不在人間了.
(My) late mother also got old, (my) late father also got old; they don't exist now, they aren't in the world now.
